item.title: ICE watchdog in Santa Cruz County experiencing a monthslong surge in volunteer interest
item.description: Organizers with a local rapid response group told the Sentinel that they experienced a noticeable rise in training registrations in October or November of last year and the trend has continued ever since.

item.title: Body found in Bonny Doon last month identified as missing woman
item.description: The Santa Cruz County Sheriff Coroner’s Office identified the body recovered on Jan. 18 in the area of Smith Grade and Moore Ranch Road as 73-year-old Jeanne Burke, who was reported missing in November.
